When PduR_<DstLo>TriggerTransmit is called and will return E_OK according to [SWS_PduR_00819], the oldest FIFO entry shall be copied and then removed. If afterwards the FIFO queue is not empty <DstLo>_Transmit shall be called with the oldest I-PDU of the FIFO.

If trigger transmit data provision is used with a FIFO: when PduR_<DstLo>TriggerTransmit is called and will return E_OK accord- ing to [SWS_PduR_00819], the oldest FIFO entry shall be copied and then removed. If afterwards the FIFO queue is not empty <DstLo>_Transmit shall be called with the oldest I-PDU of the FIFO.
